comments.author: github-actions
comments.body:
🟡 Medium This manual loading of the `IntelligenceRouter` is redundant because `run_integrated_prescan_stage` (Stage 0) already handles importing from `prescan_import_dir` and returning the router. Removing this avoids double-loading and ensures that the router initialization is consistently handled through the integrated Stage 0 flow.

```suggestion
    router = None
```

comments.author: github-actions
comments.body:
🟠 High This condition prevents `run_integrated_prescan_stage` from executing when `--prescan-import-dir` is provided. However, `run_integrated_prescan_stage` is designed to handle imported prescans (Step 1 in that function) and write the necessary `prescan_stage_receipt.json`. By skipping it here, you lose the receipt and the global `_ACTIVE_INTELLIGENCE_ROUTER` update for imported runs.

```suggestion
    if not cfg.prescan_skip:
```

comments.author: github-actions
comments.body:
🟠 High When using a `routing_plan`, `base_url` is hardcoded to `None`. This will cause failures if the selected provider is `xai` (or any other non-OpenAI provider), as the client will default to the OpenAI base URL. It should respect the configured `xai_base_url` for non-OpenAI providers, consistent with the fallback logic.

```suggestion
            base_url = None if provider == "openai" else self.config.xai_base_url
```

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: RunnerConfig defines `max_cost_usd` twice (one earlier in the dataclass and again here). In a dataclass, the later field overwrites the earlier definition, which is confusing and can break defaults/type expectations. Remove the duplicate and keep a single `max_cost_usd` field in the class.

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: `online_authorized` is being derived from `cfg.prescan_online or cfg.allow_online_llm or cfg.live_ok`. Using `live_ok` as an implicit authorization means simply exporting the live-execution consent env var can silently enable online LLM spend in prescan, even when neither `--prescan-online` nor `--allow-online-llm` is set. Drop `cfg.live_ok` from this decision (or require an explicit flag) so online prescan remains fail-closed.

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: When a routing plan is provided, this code indexes `selected_route["provider"]` / `["model_id"]` / `["api_key_env"]` directly. If the routing plan is missing any of these keys (or has a malformed route entry), this will raise `KeyError` and crash prescan instead of failing closed with a clear error. Validate required keys (e.g., via `.get()` checks) and return `None` with an actionable log message when the plan is invalid.

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: These prescan flags are appended to the runner args regardless of `effective_version`. If a user runs pipeline v4 and sets any of these options, `run_extraction_v4.py` will receive unknown CLI flags and fail. Add a guard that either (a) only registers/accepts these options when `--version v5`, or (b) errors early when any prescan-related flag is set for non-v5 runs.

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: This test file lives under `services/.../tests`, but repo `pytest.ini` sets `testpaths = tests` and also lists `services` under `norecursedirs`, so it won’t run in the default CI pytest invocation. Move these tests under `tests/` (or adjust the CI collection strategy) so the new online-gate behavior is actually enforced by the main test suite.

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: `Path` is imported but never used in this test module, which will trip flake8/linters. Remove the unused import.

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: Stage 0 prescan is only executed when `prescan_import_dir` is not set, but `run_integrated_prescan_stage()` already contains logic to handle `cfg.prescan_import_dir` and write the stage receipt. As written, imported-prescan runs won’t create `runs/<id>/prescan/` or write `prescan_stage_receipt.json`, which conflicts with the stated receipt contract. Consider calling `run_integrated_prescan_stage()` whenever prescan isn’t skipped and letting it decide between import vs local run (or write the receipt in the import path here).

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: This proof artifact is being added under `proof/`, but `.gitignore` ignores `proof/` and only allow-lists a few specific `proof/rte-...*.proof.json` ledgers. `proof/rte_v5_full_prescan_integration.proof.json` is not in the allow-list, so committing it deviates from the repo’s proof hygiene rules. Either remove it from the PR or rename/allow-list it explicitly (and update `.gitignore`) if it’s intended to be tracked long-term.

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: On `ImportError`, the integrated prescan stage returns early without writing `prescan_stage_receipt.json`. If the receipt is meant to be present for every v5 run (even when prescan can’t run), consider writing a receipt with a distinct status (e.g., `unavailable`) before returning so operators can reliably audit what happened.
